mapper.select: SELECT o.*, p.`name` AS productName, p.`img` AS productImg, pt.`name` AS typeName, c.coupon_name as userCouponsName, u.user_name as userName FROM `gift_order` o LEFT JOIN `gift_product` p ON o.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN `gift_product_type` pt ON o.type_id = pt.id LEFT JOIN `gift_coupon` c ON o.user_coupons_id = c.id LEFT JOIN `tb_user` u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} and o.status in (6 ,7, 8) order by o.create_time desc
